entries.subject: Size: Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2006) Table 3 radius
entries.finding: Sao is drawn at the 22 km radius that Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2006), Table 3, estimate for S/2002 N2 from its R-band brightness with an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04; JPL's satellite discovery table identifies S/2002 N2 as Sao. The size rests on the assumed albedo and is not a measurement.
